summary: User connected a crypto wallet to a fraudulent airdrop website which resulted in the wallet being drained. After posting about the loss the user accepted an offer from a purported recovery service and was scammed again with total reported losses of $2400.
prevention: Verify airdrop websites before connecting a wallet or approving transactions / Never pay or provide wallet access to unsolicited recovery services
classification_warning: includes secondary recovery scam after initial airdrop scam
